strategies.name: Pythag edge side
strategies.definition: Bet side whose Pythagorean win share exceeds opponent by ≥ 0.10, in weeks 1–18, flat stake 1u, settled on official final score.

gate_results.G3_sample: FAIL (n=136 graded games league-wide; per-strategy n far below 300)

strategies.name: Net-PPG favorite
strategies.definition: Bet model-v1 side when |fair_margin| ≥ 3.0 and model agrees with season net PPG sign.
strategies.correlation_to_other: high (shares inputs with S1) — must be tested jointly, not independently

strategies.name: Low-total under
strategies.definition: Bet under when model fair_total ≤ 43.0 AND both teams' def_ppg ≤ league avg (22.96).

strategies.name: Injury-adjusted fade
strategies.definition: Downgrade a side whose official injury report lists a starting-caliber QB/RB/WR/OL/CB/LB as DNP or Out; fade only if model margin also flips sign after manual adjustment.
strategies.status: BLOCKED — backup identity unverified; manual step violates no-manual-input rule; keep as research only

strategies.name: Two-leg parlay (S1∧S3)
strategies.definition: Parlay one S1 side with one S3 under; correlated-leg check REQUIRED before pricing: if r(legs) > 0.10 or p<0.05, price with joint probability, not product of marginals.
